description: This file defines the ArticlesController class in an ASP.NET Core application, handling HTTP requests related to articles, including listing, retrieving details, creating, editing, and deleting articles. It uses MediatR for command/query dispatching and includes authorization attributes for protected actions.

classes.name: ArticlesController
classes.description: Controller class that handles HTTP requests related to articles. Supports listing, retrieving, creating, editing, and deleting articles, integrating with MediatR for command/query processing and applying authorization where needed.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list articles with optional filtering by tag, author, favorited, limit, and offset.

methods.name: GetFeed
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list the user's feed of articles, similar to Get but with the IsFeed flag set to true.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Handles GET request to retrieve details of a single article identified by slug.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new article, requiring authorization.

methods.name: Edit
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing article identified by slug, requiring authorization.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove an article identified by slug, requiring authorization.
